nodes.name: Claim CLEANED Leads
nodes.notes: SELECT ... FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED, so parallel executions never hand the same lead to two workers. A claim older than 20 minutes is treated as abandoned and reissued, which is how a crashed run resumes instead of stranding leads at CLEANED.

nodes.name: Domain Available?
nodes.notes: Apollo searches on a domain. Without one, go straight to the fallback rather than burning a credit.

nodes.name: Enrich (Website Fallback)
nodes.notes: Runs when the paid provider finds nobody. This is what keeps founder-led businesses - the best prospects - in the pipeline.

nodes.name: Merge Contacts + Pick Decision Maker
nodes.notes: Ranks contacts by company size: founder/owner for small businesses, the person who owns the support queue for larger ones.

nodes.name: Store Contacts
nodes.notes: Upsert on (company_id, email). Contacts without an email are inserted once per run and de-duplicated by the partial unique index.

nodes.name: Classify Failure
nodes.notes: Uses the same classifier as the test suite: 429 backs off, 5xx retries, 401/422 dead-letters immediately.
